scenes.title: Past Life · The Borrowed Pen
scenes.summary: Before the final round of the Meridian State Academic Championship, Shen Man asks Lin Zhixia to lend her a pen. Lin hands one over without thinking. When Shen Man returns it, her fingertip lingers on the barrel for half a second.
scenes.text: MERIDIAN STATE ACADEMIC CHAMPIONSHIP — FINALS. The last individual written round is about to begin. Lin Zhixia sits in the waiting area, silently reciting formulas. Shen Man walks up. "Zhixia, let me borrow a pen. Mine just ran dry." Lin Zhixia pulls one from her pencil case and hands it over without a thought. Shen Man takes it, scribbles twice on scratch paper, and gives it back. "Thanks. This one writes nice." Lin Zhixia doesn't care. She doesn't see it — when Shen Man returns the pen, her fingertip lingers on the barrel for half a second.

scenes.title: Past Life · The Night the Rankings Drop
scenes.summary: Lin Zhixia refreshes the live ranking page and gets 487. Her arbitration review is denied. Shen Man tops the state with 330, and the blue mark on her palm fades.
scenes.text: Late at night, Lin Zhixia sits in front of the screen, refreshing the live ranking page for the Meridian State Academic Championship. The number that pops up is 487. She refreshes a dozen times. Her hands shake harder each time. Her mother leans in to look, then drops into a chair, legs giving out. Her homeroom teacher, Old Chen, is stunned on the phone. "Impossible. I've taught for twenty years... I'll file an arbitration review for you right now." Three days later, the review is denied. The reply is four words: Score is correct. Meanwhile, Shen Man tops the state with 330. In a live interview she says, "I just performed above my level" — then her eyes go blank for a second. She looks down at the hand that took the pen. A faint blue mark on her palm is fading. The comments flood in: "Rich and she still works this hard."

scenes.title: Past Life · The Rooftop
scenes.summary: On the rooftop, Shen Man admits she swapped the scores and bribed the review. She pushes Lin Zhixia off the roof and stages it as a suicide.
scenes.text: The day college applications close, an anonymous text lures her to the rooftop. Shen Man drops all pretense. "You think I got here on my dad? His three hundred grand bought the review. The swap — I did that myself." Lin Zhixia: "You?" Shen Man holds out her hand. The blue mark on her palm is so faint it's almost gone. "That pen of yours wrote nice. Guess why I had to borrow yours?" Lin Zhixia turns to leave — to report it, to call the police. Footsteps close in behind her. Two hands slam into her back. In the rushing wind of the fall, Shen Man's voice drifts down from the roof's edge: "Next life, don't lend your pen to just anyone." What the world called a suicide was a murder from start to finish.

scenes.title: Rebirth · The Switch
scenes.summary: Lin Zhixia wakes on the morning of the Meridian State Academic Championship finals. She writes three lines of a plan and places Zhou Yu's pen in the outer pocket of her pencil case.
scenes.text: She opens her eyes. It's the morning of the Meridian State Academic Championship finals. The contest badge on the desk, her mother's porridge by the door, the date on her phone — every detail matches her memory. Lin Zhixia pinches the back of her hand. It hurts. She sits at the desk for ten minutes, then writes three lines in her notebook: "One — she borrows the pen to swap scores. The pen is the anchor. Two — don't lend her mine. Three — the rooftop push. This time she hits air. And I record it." She closes the notebook and checks her pencil case: her own pen, a spare, and one Zhou Yu left on her desk last week. She puts Zhou Yu's pen in the outer pocket.

scenes.title: Rebirth · The Exam Room
scenes.summary: Before the last subject, Shen Man borrows a pen again. Lin Zhixia hands her Zhou Yu's pen. When Shen Man returns it, her fingertip lingers for half a second again.
scenes.text: Before the last subject begins, Shen Man comes over, just as expected. "Zhixia, let me borrow a pen. Mine ran dry." Lin Zhixia smiles and pulls the pen from the outer pocket. "Here." Shen Man takes it and scribbles twice. Lin Zhixia notices her grip is strange — like she's feeling for something. When she returns it, her fingertip lingers on the barrel for half a second. Exactly like the past life. Lin Zhixia takes it back, drops it in her pencil case, and never touches that pen again.

scenes.title: Replay · The Scores Drop
scenes.summary: On ranking night, Lin Zhixia gets 940, Zhou Yu gets 487, and Shen Man scores only 330 and posts about it in the class group.
scenes.text: Ranking night. Lin Zhixia enters her contestant number. The screen flashes: 940 — exactly her estimate. She stares for a few seconds, refreshes, and it's still 940. Her phone rings. Zhou Yu's voice shakes. "Zhixia, I got 487. But I estimated around 330!" Lin Zhixia grips the phone and slowly smiles — then stops mid-smile. Meanwhile, the class group explodes. Shen Man posts a screenshot of the ranking page: "330. How is this possible?" The comments go silent for a long time. Someone finally asks, carefully, "Man, maybe file an arbitration review?" Shen Man doesn't reply again.

scenes.title: Zhou Yu's Score
scenes.summary: Zhou Yu's review confirms 487. Shen Man barges in and lets slip that she knows Zhou Yu's original score. Lin Zhixia reveals the truth about the swap pen, and Zhou Yu decides to ally with her.
scenes.text: The next day, Zhou Yu rushes to Lin Zhixia's house, phone held up. "The arbitration review came back. 487, confirmed. But I only had 330 before!" Before Lin Zhixia can speak, Shen Man shoves the door open. She snatches the phone from Zhou Yu's hand. When she sees 487, it slips out: "You only had 330!" Zhou Yu stares at her. "The live ranking page just refreshed. How do you know my original score?" The room goes dead quiet. Shen Man's face changes. She throws the phone down and turns to leave. Zhou Yu shuts the door behind her. "She knows my original score." Lin Zhixia takes out the pen. "Before the last round of the Meridian finals, she came to borrow a pen. I handed her yours." Zhou Yu looks at the pen, then at Shen Man's 330 on the live ranking page. It clicks. "She tried to steal your 940 — and gave me her 487 instead?" Lin Zhixia nods. Zhou Yu pockets her phone. "I'll keep this score. Her debt — we settle it together."

scenes.title: Alliance · The Trap
scenes.summary: Shen Man calls and threatens Lin Zhixia. Lin records it and sets a rooftop meeting for the next night. Zhou Yu sets up a livestream so the whole school can witness it.
scenes.text: That night, Shen Man calls. Her voice shakes. "It was you. The pen you lent me wasn't yours." Lin Zhixia hits record. "I never said it was. You borrowed the pen. You did the swap." Shen Man grits her teeth. "Give me back the 487." Zhou Yu, sitting nearby, silently points at the rooftop. Lin Zhixia lets out a deliberate laugh. "Want it back? Tomorrow night, eight o'clock. The usual place. Tell me to my face how the swap works." Silence on the line for a few seconds. "Come, and I'll kill you again." The call ends. Zhou Yu mounts a second phone on the bookshelf. The livestream test light turns green. "She wants a rooftop. We'll give her one the whole school can see."

scenes.title: The Rooftop · Livestream
scenes.summary: On the rooftop, Shen Man admits the swap system's rules and her intent to kill. Zhou Yu streams it secretly, and the viewer count surges.
scenes.text: The next night at eight, Lin Zhixia stands alone in the center of the rooftop. The action camera clipped to her bag strap faces the door. Zhou Yu hides in the stairwell, streaming from a second phone. Shen Man pushes through the door. The blue mark on her palm flickers. Lin Zhixia: "My 940 didn't move. Zhou Yu became 487. You're left with 330. Why?" Shen Man finally drops the mask. "Because the system only recognizes the pen's original owner! The borrower's score swaps with the owner's final published score. I meant to swap with you. How was I supposed to know that pen was Zhou Yu's?" Lin Zhixia: "So you wanted my 940." Shen Man sneers. "Yes. But you made me swap with the wrong person. Once the scores are published, the swap locks. No one can undo it. So what if Zhou Yu has my 487? Does she deserve it?" In the stairwell, the viewer count climbs wildly. Zhou Yu stares at the screen: three thousand, five thousand, ten thousand. Shen Man notices nothing. She steps toward Lin Zhixia. "You ruined me. So I'll make sure you never walk off this roof."

scenes.title: Replay · The Miss and the Trial
scenes.summary: Shen Man's push misses. Zhou Yu exposes her via livestream. Police arrest Shen Man. Months later at trial, the judge convicts on real-world evidence, and Shen Man cannot explain her motive.
scenes.text:
Shen Man lunges at Lin Zhixia. Same angle as the past life. Same force. Lin Zhixia is ready. She steps aside. Shen Man hits air and crashes into the railing. The rooftop door swings open. Zhou Yu walks out, phone streaming. "Go on. Over ten thousand people at school heard it — whose score you tried to steal, and who you tried to push." Shen Man goes pale and lunges for the phone. Sirens close in from the stairwell. Security and police burst onto the roof and pin her down. She's still screaming. "The 487 was mine! They set me up!" Lin Zhixia looks at her. "You borrowed the pen. You did the swap. You threw the punch."

Months later, the trial. The prosecution submits the death threat from Shen Man's call, the rooftop livestream, the front-facing footage from the action camera, and the scene investigation. The judge states plainly: "This court does not try a so-called past life, nor does it need to prove whether the system you speak of exists. This court tries the death threat you made in reality and the push you carried out on the rooftop." Then he holds up the screenshot of Shen Man's 330. "But this explains your motive. The scores had just been published. How did you know Zhou Yu originally had 330? And why do you insist her 487 belongs to you?" Shen Man opens her mouth. Not a single word comes out.

scenes.title: The Reckoning
scenes.summary: The court finds Shen Man guilty of attempted murder. The arbitration review upholds the three official scores. Shen Man's college eligibility is revoked. Zhou Yu confirms her admission to Lin Zhixia.
scenes.text: Based on the death threat, the livestream footage, and the scene evidence, the court finds Shen Man guilty of attempted murder. As for the score swap, the arbitration review can only follow real procedures — checking the answer sheets and system records. No trace of conventional cheating or manual tampering is found. The three official scores stand: Lin Zhixia 940, Zhou Yu 487, Shen Man 330. The supernatural swap cannot be used as a basis for the verdict, but no real-world means can undo it either. Shen Man's college eligibility is revoked due to the criminal case and school disciplinary action. The day the admission letters arrive, Zhou Yu sends Lin Zhixia a photo. "487. Admission confirmed. She tried to steal your 940 and handed me her score instead." Lin Zhixia replies: "This time she finally solved one problem right."

scenes.title: Epilogue
scenes.summary: Lin Zhixia's admission letter arrives. Zhou Yu visits with her own letter and milk tea. They press the mysterious pen under the glass of the desk. Deep in the barrel, a faint blue light flickers and goes out.
scenes.text: The day Lin Zhixia's admission letter arrives, her mother wipes the envelope three times before daring to open it. The doorbell rings. Zhou Yu stands outside, holding her own letter and two cups of milk tea. "One 940, one 487. Both made it." Lin Zhixia smiles and takes the tea. Zhou Yu sets the pen between the two letters. "What about this?" Lin Zhixia presses it under the glass of the desk. "Keep it. Not to remember the system — to remember she lost to her own greed." They turn and walk out of the room. The camera holds on the pen. After a few quiet seconds, deep in the barrel, a faint blue light flickers — then goes out.
